notes: Primary approved P2 basket for the vectorbt rolling-OLS pair: EURUSD.DWX is the D1 host at registry slot 0 and GBPUSD.DWX is the traded hedge leg at slot 1.

This logical basket supersedes the legacy physical-leg fan-out. Those presets omitted the partner binding, and the former _per_instance host was not an MT5 symbol, so their Q02 outcomes are not evidence for a configured two-leg pair.

AUDUSD.DWX/NZDUSD.DWX and the card's optional GER40.DWX/NDX.DWX pair remain approved alternates but are not mixed into this one-instance Q02 identity. GER40.DWX maps to registry symbol GDAXI.DWX if an alternate receives a dedicated logical basket.
